title: Taiwan votes in local elections to choose mayors, other leaders
paragraphs: Taiwan is choosing mayors, council members and other local leaders across its 22 cities and counties in an election that has been unusually competitive in some of the island’s biggest cities.
Polls opened at 8am (00:00 GMT) on Saturday and will close at 4pm (08:00 GMT), with results expected early in the evening.
Voters are casting ballots at schools, temples and community centres.
